name: MelodyRecognitionEngine
description: Real-time Burst-compiled humming and acoustic instrument melody recognition engine for Unity 6 with YIN pitch tracking, Hum/Instrument DSP profiles, relative-interval & absolute-pitch matching, Guided/Learn Mode, custom songs, uGUI Musical Staff HUD, and UI Toolkit Workbench.

name: GachaEngine
description: Configurable gacha banner, soft/hard pity, and drop-rate simulator for Unity 6 with custom rarity tiers, Canvas/3D reveal hooks, and 1-hour refreshed JSON pull history.

name: CommonEventsEngine
description: RPG Maker-inspired Common Events, global Switches/Variables, Self-Switches, Inventory/Gold ledger, and tick-driven command scripting framework for Unity 6 with built-in uGUI Dialogue Box, Screen Fader, and a UI Toolkit Event Workbench.

name: UnityAuthCore
description: Backend-agnostic authentication and typed REST API framework for Unity 6 with pluggable IAuthBackendAdapter, single-flight 401 token refresh, Unity Multiplayer connection approval, OpenAPI 3.0 spec, and an optional Dockerized reference server.

name: NetAuditToolkit
description: Unity 6 Editor static analyzer and hierarchy badge overlay that flags NGO, Mirror, and FishNet issues across scenes, prefabs, RPCs, and bandwidth.

name: NetSimToolkit
description: Localhost UDP/TCP network condition simulator, live bandwidth profiler, chaos timeline runner, and QA repro exporter for Unity 6.

name: GameBalancer
description: Unity 6 UI Toolkit workbench for tuning progression curves, Monte Carlo loot and pity odds, combat TTK matrices, and resource economies.

name: CharacterMotor
description: Modular Unity 6 character controller supporting CharacterController, Rigidbody, and Rigidbody2D through swappable locomotion modules.

name: PlayablesAnimatorController
description: Code-driven 2D and 3D animation controller for Unity 6 built on the Playables API, skipping AnimatorController state graphs entirely.

name: AssetImportRules
description: Rule-driven Unity 6 Editor pipeline and UI Toolkit workbench for auditing and optimizing Sprite, UI, Texture, 3D Model, and Audio imports.

name: BugReportToolkit
description: In-game Unity bug reporter that bundles screenshots, console logs, and system diagnostics into ZIP archives or posts them straight to webhooks.

name: SpreadsheetToScriptableObjects
description: Unity Editor importer that parses .csv and .xlsx spreadsheets directly into typed ScriptableObject assets.

name: UnityEventAuditor
description: Unity Editor inspector and scanner for locating, filtering, auditing, and cleaning up broken or unused UnityEvent listeners across scenes and prefabs.

name: SaveEncryptionToolkit
description: Pluggable encryption and serialization utilities for Unity save managers, separating storage security from your game's save schema.

name: ScriptableBatchTool
description: Unity Editor window for batch-creating, renaming, and bulk-editing ScriptableObject assets in one place.

name: DebugCommandSystem
description: Extendable in-game Unity debug console built on the New Input System, with strongly typed commands, autocomplete, and live suggestions.
